newsitem.title: USA: Hills Stores sees Q3 charge of $0.22/shr.
newsitem.headline: Hills Stores sees Q3 charge of $0.22/shr.

text.p: Hills Stores Co said Tuesday that it will record an extraordinary after-tax charge of about $2.2 million, or $0.22 a share, in its third fiscal quarter ending November 2.
The charge results from the writeoff of deferred financing costs from the early extinguishment of old loans and a credit facility.
The company said it closed on a new $300 million revolving credit facility that will be effective through September 1999.

The company attributed the charge to costs associated with the new facility, including a commitment fee of 3/8 percentage point on the unused portion of the facility and front-end fees of $2.25 million to be amortized over the life of the facility.
